info.name: ShorelineBuildingsAPI
info.description:
Test documentation for the Shoreline Buildings GraphQL API.

- URL to use the API: [https://cu3156.camp.lnu.se/api/graphql](https://cu3156.camp.lnu.se/api/graphql)
    
- Playground to test the API: [https://cu3156.camp.lnu.se/api/graphiql](https://cu3156.camp.lnu.se/api/graphiql)
    

🔐 Authentication is done via a separate authentication server, using JWT (JSON Web Tokens) and REST requests.

In GraphQL Playground add the Authorization header like this:

```
{
   "authorization": "Bearer yourAccessTokenHere"
}

 ```
